fields.statement: At commit 2af1b61 ran go test ./internal/api -run TestSessionRunFreshSessionWhenTranscriptGone -count=1 -v: PASS. A fake agent's transcript says 'limited', and the run's sleep during the usage-limit pause deletes that transcript. session.run then launched a second time with the same session ID, Resume=false and the stored first prompt 'do the step', so it started a fresh session instead of resuming. The response's warnings record 'started a fresh session for the step instead of resuming'. Read the diff of internal/api/session_run.go: after the pause, readTranscript decides between resume (transcript present) and fresh launch (transcript missing), and the fresh-session warning is appended to resp.Warnings. Without the change, the second launch would have Resume=true and the test would fail. make check passed (exit 0).
